styleLock.direction: minimal creator-audio ecommerce, cool porcelain and clean
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool porcelain #F4F6F7 for packshot and contents screens, soft mist blue-grey #CBD6DC studio fields for wear screens, pale slate interiors for scene screens, deep slate #26303A ground for the macro screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused front-left key at 5500K with a cool bounce fill, one restrained rim sweep, gentle contact shadows, cool neutral grade, no harsh specular bursts
styleLock.surfaceSystem: cool porcelain board #F4F6F7, washed greige linen #D8D4CC on the detail screen, deep slate #26303A macro ground
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held inside the style system only, every glyph area left blank for post-composited copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip outlines in glacier cyan #4F8C96, no filled pictograms
styleLock.presentationRules: stable straight-on to slight 3/4 product scale, clip arm, button panel and plug edge always readable, never overlapped by props or hands
noDrift: no rendered in-image copy, badges, digits or model names
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal creator-audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool porcelain #F4F6F7, mist blue-grey #CBD6DC, deep slate #26303A and one glacier cyan accent #4F8C96; cool neutral lighting with a soft diffused front-left key at 5500K, a cool bounce fill, one restrained rim sweep and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip outlines only; matte charcoal product bodies with fine surface grain, one controlled specular roll and a single soft status dot; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic scaffolding; stable straight-on to slight 3/4 product scale and centring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.displayName: 冷瓷白底三件立姿主图
shots.intent: 搜索列表首图，用一枚接收器配两枚夹式的立姿剪影赢一眼点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, upright units centred, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key front-left softbox key with a bounce card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows
shots.props: two foam caps and one small flat connector adapter at the upper right
shots.whitespace: even margin all around, no extra whitespace and no copy band
shots.promptTemplate: Seamless-field marketplace hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A pair of clipped units standing upright beside one flat-plug receiver, photographed straight-on at eye level, centred and symmetrical so the search thumbnail reads as one clean silhouette, every body fully visible and nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and a bounce card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding each piece so nothing floats. Seamless cool porcelain background #F4F6F7, matte bodies showing fine surface grain and one restrained specular roll along each shoulder. Props limited to two foam caps and one small flat connector adapter floating clear at the upper right corner. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame. Even margin all around the product, no extra whitespace and no copy band. 1:1, 8K commercial electronics quality. Negative: no wordmark, logo or model lettering on any body, no printed or rendered text of any kind, no packaging art, no hands, no watermark or QR code, no tinted gradient background, no duplicated or merged product parts, no clipped edges.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图1 近白底上两枚夹式机身配一枚带扁平插头的接收器竖立并列，右上角另置两枚海绵套与一枚触点转接头，机身仅一枚绿色状态点；图2 灰色针织衫领口佩戴一枚带灰色绒毛罩的机身，颈部以上出画，左侧米灰墙面留大字区；图3 同屏三格（桌前手机三脚架自拍录制、高领衫胸口佩戴特写、站立远距对镜头讲话），顶部一行大字；图4 两枚带绒罩机身躺在浅亚麻布面上、各插一条短线缆，暖侧光长投影，顶部大字讲连续录制时长；图5 两人各佩戴一枚绒罩机身、前景手机横置在小三脚架上，屏内为录制界面含红点与电平条，左上大字含双麦与无线距离数值；图6 浅灰底俯视全家福（两枚夹机、一枚带插头接收器、两枚海绵套、一卷短线缆、两枚绒罩、一枚触点转接头），每件下方英文品名与件数。品类判定：主产品为夹在衣领就近拾音、经接收器直插手机的迷你无线领夹麦克风，核心是音频采集而非手机本体或支架，故判为手机数码／耳机音频，与源站挂载类目无关。与库内同品类既有模版的差异：本套源图无痛点分栏、无波形前后对比、无悬浮同心弧卖点与六格矩阵，改由领口佩戴特写、三格上手矩阵与布面躺充微距承担中段说服，因此分镜逐镜不同构、属可转化形态；为避免视觉体系撞车，色板与背景由暖燕麦／米黄／亚麻暖调整体改为冷瓷白／雾灰蓝／石板墨蓝加冰川青强调的冷调体系。已剥离：源品牌字标与系列名、机身字样、原平台排名与店铺字样、全部原英文标题句式与图内文案、连续录制时长与无线距离等数字主张（改为空白状态条与空标签框）、出镜人物面容与身份（改为颈部以下裁切或背身）、手机屏幕内的录制界面与电平读数（改为空白取景框）、配件上的机型适配插画品牌特征。
